# GCloud Cafe — Practical Cloud Architecture & Certifications

> GCloud Cafe (https://gcloudcafe.com) is an engineering platform providing practical tutorials, exam preparation guides (Red Hat EX280, CKA, GCP, AWS), and real-time cloud micro-news (Cloud Pulse).

## Core Pages
- [GCloud Cafe Homepage](https://gcloudcafe.com/): Practical cloud architecture tutorials, exam guides, and platform overview.
- [Cloud Pulse Live Feed](https://gcloudcafe.com/pulse/): Real-time community-ranked cloud updates and micro-news feed.
- [All Blog Articles](https://gcloudcafe.com/blog/): Technical deep dives on OpenShift, Kubernetes, GCP, and AWS.
- [Categories Index](https://gcloudcafe.com/categories/): Browse technical guides by category.
- [About GCloud Cafe](https://gcloudcafe.com/about/): Platform mission and author profile.

## Key Technical Guides
- [EX280 OpenShift Administrator Series](https://gcloudcafe.com/blog/passing-ex280-exam-part-2-technical-side/): Deep dive into NetworkPolicies, Edge Routes, and OpenShift 4.x administration.
- [CKA Exam Readiness Guide](https://gcloudcafe.com/blog/cka-exam-readiness/): Hands-on Kubernetes cluster configuration and exam strategy.
- [GCP Generative AI Leader Guide](https://gcloudcafe.com/blog/gcp-generative-ai-leader/): Gemini models, Vertex AI, and enterprise cloud AI deployments.

## Feeds & Indexes
- [GCloud Cafe RSS Feed](https://gcloudcafe.com/index.xml): Site-wide RSS feed.
- [Search Index JSON](https://gcloudcafe.com/searchindex.json): Programmatic search index endpoint.
